tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na maḥshrī kā la tsakra ya/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa ni/ bsal gtan nang mtshams byed pa dang*/ /rgyud sde 'chad nyan dbang bskur rigs/ /chos ldan rmi lam 'khrugs pa'am/ /rnal 'byor nyams 'chags gso ba dang*/ sems can tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /dbyangs dang rnga brdung 'di skad do/ / hūṃ/ spros bral chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gzugs sku mkha' khyab sems can 'dren pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ /mdun phyogs 'ja' tshon pa drwa 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /sna tshogs padma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i steng*/ /seṅge brgyad btegs rin chen sna tshogs khri/ /nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /khyed la phun tshogs mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /lta spyod rnam dag mchod yon kun nas 'khyil/ /thos bsam sgom gsum dag pa'i zhabs bsil mngar/ /sgo gsum dge bcu'i me tog sil mar bkram/ /sdom gsum dag pa'i spos mchog sprin du 'khrigs/ /bslab gsum yon tan ny-i 'od mar me 'bar/ /tshogs gsum rgya mtsho spos chu'i dri mchog bltams/ /'khor gsum dag pa'i ro brgya zhal zas sbyor/ /theg gsum rol mo'i sil snyan sna tshogs dkrol/ /bka' 'khor gsum gyi rnga chen 'khar rnga brdung*/ /sde snod gsum gyi dung sgra khams gsum sgrogs/ / rgyud sde bzhi yi ba dan mkha' la phyar/ /rdzogs ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyen du bsgreng*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis/ /mtha' bzhi las grol ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang*/ /'gyur med rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskang*/ /gzhom med sgra ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/

/dpag med zhing nas mtha' yas sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rgyal sras khro rgyal rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /spyan ras gzigs la rgyud 'grel gsan pa'i mchog /grub chen dus zhabs chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis mngon du gyur pa yi/ /grub chen dus zhabs chung ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam snang gangs chen mtsho la chos gsan pa'i/ /mkhas mchog nā lend+ra pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sgrol mas lung bstan bod khams mun sel ba//paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// gsang 'dus zhal gzigs mngon shes rdzu 'phrul can/ /blo ldan 'bro ston lotstsha'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nyin zhag bco lngar 'od gsal ngang la bzhugs// mnyam med lha rje sgom pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /zla gcig ting 'dzin sgom pa'i gtsug tor 'phags/ /sgro ston gnam la brtsegs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /shāka thub la sogs sangs rgyas dpag med gzigs/ /yu mo chos kyi ra chen thugs dam bskang*/ /byin rlabs mdzad tsam skal ldan smin grol mdzad/ /sras mchog dharmā shwa ra'i thugs dam bskang/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i zhal gzigs lung bstan thob/ /mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer thugs dam bskang*/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ /ma cig sprul sku jo 'bum thugs dam bskang*/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mngon shes thogs med ldan/ /grub thob se mo che ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su lung bstan thob/ /chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lha sa'i jo bos byang chub lung bstan pa/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer thugs dam bskang*/ / dus 'khor ye shes dkyil 'khor mngon sum gzigs/ /kun spang thugs rje brtson 'grus thugs dam bskang*/ /chos nyid bde gshegs snying po dngos su brnyes/ /byang sems rgyal ba ye shes thugs dam bskang*/

/rlung sems dbang 'dus yi dam dpag med gzigs/ /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /༈ dus gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus dngos/ /kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang*/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel/ /chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ /mang thos rig pas phas rgol tshar gcod mdzad/ /mkhas mchog nya dbon kun dga'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i ngo mtshar snang ba'i gnyen/ /'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros thugs dam bskang*/ /rgya chen shes bya'i gter gyur 'jig rten mig /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i thugs dam bskang*/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod zab mo'i nges gsang rtogs/ /mkhas pa nam mkha' chos skyong thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam mang gzhung lugs mkhyen pa'i gangs ri skyongs/ / paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang thugs dam bskang*/ /mdo sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'khor los bsgyur/ /lāo chen ratna bha dra'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gdams pa'i chu klung ma lus sdud po mchog /dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog thugs dam bskang*/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i nyams rtogs mthar son pa'i/ /mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /༈ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mdo rgyud man ngag mchog la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /mtshungs med rin chen rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mkhyen stobs dpung gis rgyal bstan gdugs dkar 'degs/ /mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ /rdzogs ldan grub pa'i brtul zhugs nyams bzhes pa'i/ /grub chen ngag dbang 'phrin las thugs dam bskang*/ /brgyud gsum byin rlabs chu bo 'dus pa'i gter/ /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ /zab lam bstan pa'i gsang mdzod 'dod 'jo'i mkhan/ / rnal 'byor mkhas btsun dar rgyas thugs dam bskang*/

/zab lam gdams pa'i 'khor lo phyogs bcur bskor/ /kun bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ /gang la gang 'dul thabs mkhas rol rtsed 'chang*/ /nus ldan lhun grub rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /smin grol bdud rtsi'i 'gro phan bla med spyod/ /dkon mchog 'jig med rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rjes rang gzugs gar/ /ngag dbang chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor mthar son pa/ /ngag dbang chos kyi 'phags pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal dbyings su rol/ /ngag dbang chos 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ ༈ gzung 'dzin 'khrul zad rgyud sde rab 'byams bdag /kun dga' bsod nams dpal ldan thugs dam bskang*/ /dbang lung gdams ngag rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /ngag dbang chos kyi rnal 'byor thugs dam bskang*/ / gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po mngon gsal ba//ngag dbang mkhas grub dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*// yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i zhal gzigs pa/ /ngag dbang bstan pa gsal byed thugs dam bskang*/ /yi dam rgyud sde rab 'byams spro bsdu mdzad/ /ngag dbang rdo rje bzang po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /don dam gnas lugs bla ma'i zhal mjal ba/ /ngag dbang dkon mchog dar rgyas thugs dam bskang*/ /gzhan stong dbu mas 'dzam gling khyab mdzad pa/ /ngag dbang blo gros grags pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ / dus 'khor bskang ba'i kha skong 'dzam thang gtsang ba'i gdan rabs rim byon ltar blo bzang chos 'phel bas bris pa'o/ / ༈ de dag ni dbang brgyud ded pa yin te/ man ngag nyams khrid sogs kyi brgyud pa la mos na/ mkhas btsun dar rgyas kyi mal du/ thabs lam gtum mo'i 'bar snang la spyod pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin kun dga' chos 'phel thugs dam bskang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ lhun grub rgya mtsho dang*/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal zung gi tshab tu/ mngon shes spyan gyis dus gsum sgrib med gzigs/

/rtogs ldan kun dga' chos 'byor thugs dam bskang*/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma don gyi rang bzhin mjal/ /gu ru ngag dbang rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang*/ / de sogs dbang brgyud man ngag gzhung 'grel gyi/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs rnam dag gis/ /bdag cag dpon slob skye ba kun tu yang*/ /rigs ldan bla ma chos rje yab sras kyi/ /rtag par zhal mthong lung rigs dbang 'byor nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /hūṃ/ chos dbyings 'byung lnga 'od 'phreng bskor ba'i dbus/ /gru bzhi nyi ma'i sgo khang rta babs ldan/ /mchog gsum khang brtsegs rgya phub 'degs pa'i dbus/ /sna tshogs padma zla nyi sgra gcan steng*/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mdog /sku bzhi'i zhal ldan nyi ma'i spyan chen bgrad/ / ral ba'i cod pan sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ /zla phyed mi bskyod pa yi dbu rgyan can/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rdul mun snying stobs rnam dag mgrin pa gsum/ /phyi nang dus drug dag pa'i phrag pa la/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis rnam dag dpung pa spras/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /zla phyed nyer bzhi dag pa'i phyag ngar ldan/ /phyag sor lnga lnga zla ba'i yon tan 'gags/ /sor tshig gsum gsum nyi ma'i yon tan spangs/ / bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sgra gcan rnam dag chos sku nyag gcig 'bar/ /ro rkyang dag pa'i zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis/ /bdud dang nyon mongs bsgyel ba'i snying gar mnan/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /thabs shes g.yas g.yon phyag gi dang po gnyis/ /bde stong rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam shes ma rig gcod pa'i ral gri g.yas/ /ye shes rdo rje'i go cha phub dkar g.yon/

/bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ / zag bcas bde ba gcod pa'i gri gug g.yas/ /zag med bde chen skyong mdzad thod khrag g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sgo gsum mi dge 'bugs pa'i rtse gsum g.yas/ /sku gsum yon tan rdzogs pa'i kha ṭwāṃ g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms pa'i me mda' g.yas/ /ye shes lnga ldan 'bar ba'i gzhu brdung g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rlung sems dbu mar 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu g.yas/ /thig le rtsa rlung 'ching ba'i zhags pa g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bde stong zab mo'i sgra sgrogs ḍā ru g.yas/ /theg gsum dam chos 'byung gnas rin chen g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /glo bur bum pa brdung ba'i tho ba g.yas/ /nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos pad dkar g.yon/ / bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'khor lo g.yas/ /khams gsum chos sgra sgrogs pa'i dung dkar g.yon// bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gzung 'dzin log 'dres 'bugs pa'i mdung thung g.yas/ /chos nyid stong gzugs 'char ba'i me long g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bdud bzhi dpung bcas sgrol byed dbyug pa g.yas/ /las dang nyon mongs 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /ma rig sdong po gcod pa'i dgra st+wa g.yas/ /rig byed rnam bzhi bcom pa'i tshangs mgo g.yon// bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /stag lpags rdo rje'i rgyan drug sku la spras/ /stong chen sna tshogs yum la rnam par rol/ /bde stong gnyis su med pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ yum chen lha mo gser mdog zhal bzhi ma/

/pra phab brgyad kyi phyag rnams mtshon cha 'dzin/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rab brgyan yab la 'khyud/ /stong chen sna tshogs yum gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /pha rol phyin bcu rnam dag nus ma bcu/ /bum pa bcu dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gnas skabs rigs bzhi'i sgrib pa mthar mdzad pa/ /rdo rje mtshan ma rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ /phung po rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /khams drug dag pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sangs rgyas yab yum tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /dbang po rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' drug /yul drug dag pa'i lha mos rab tu 'khyud/ /sems dpa' yab yum tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /las dbang rnam dag khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /bya ba rnam dag khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /khro rgyal yab yum tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /skye mched bcu gnyis rnam dag mchod sprin thogs/ /gzungs ma lha mo bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang*/ /lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dbyug gu rnam dag pa/ /tsartsi kā sogs gzhan mchog gtso mo brgyad/ /zung 'jug rol pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ / gsung gi lha tshaugs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /kun rdzob zla ba bcu gnyis tshigs dang rtsa/ /rnam dag lha chen bcu gnyis bzhon par bcas/ /tshes zhag sum brgya drug cu rnam dag pa//chos nyid lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// mthil bzhi gsang gtsug rnam dag shing rta'i steng*/ /khro rgyal dbyug sngon la sogs khro bo drug /'od zer can sogs khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /sgo skyong khro rgyal yab yum thugs dam bskang*//sor mo rnam dag klu dang gtum mo'i tshogs// 'dod yon dga' bde'i rang bzhin gzungs kyi lha/ /skra dang ba spu rnam dag grub pa'i tshogs/ /don dam 'byung po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang*/ /ghanṭa karṇa dga' byed nag po che/

/bhṛṃ gi ṇi sogs 'khor gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /don dam skyabs gsum thugs gsung sku'i lha/ /lhun grub ye shes 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /drug brgya so bzhi yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /chos nyid yongs rdzogs lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs rnam dag gis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams chags ma lus bskang ba dang*/ /phyi nang nyon mongs glo bur las grol nas/ /stobs sogs yon tan gdod nas kun ldan pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i snying po myur du thob par shog /hūṃ/ rdo rje khang brtsegs 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /khro rgyal rdo rje shugs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /pha rol phyin bcu rnam dag khro rgyal bcu/ /don dam zad par bcu yi thugs dam bskang*/ /stobs bcu bzhon pa ldan pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ /chos nyid gza' chen bcu yi thugs dam bskang*// ye shes dbang bcu'i bdag nyid klu rgyal bcu/ /gzhan mchog 'byung po bcu yi thugs dam bskang*/ /sde drug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas dang*/ /dur khrod 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed la/ /gling bzhi lhun po nyi zla dpag bsam shing*/ /lha mi'i longs spyod tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor bsrung skyobs zhi rgyas sogs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje nag po che/ /srin po'i gzugs can sbom thung mche ba gtsigs/ /zlum po'i stabs can rus rgyan dar gyis brgyan/ /gri thod rnam 'phrul ganṭe thugs kar 'dzin/ /skra ser sbrul rgyan tshangs rkud thod rlon spras/ /dpal ldan mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang*/ /e ka tsa ṭ-i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu ṭa ming sring dang*/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi mi nag bya khyi sogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur cig

/seng ge glang chen stag gzig dom dred sogs/ /khrab rmog dar sna rin chen sna tshogs 'dis/ /mahā kā la 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /bzhes nas thub dbang bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ /rdo rje theg pa mchog tu dar bar mdzod/ /de ltar thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag cag byang chub snying po bsgrub pa la/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rigs thams cad dang*/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog dgra bgegs zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags dang*/ /sa lam yon tan ma lus rgyas par mdzod/ /mi chen rgyal po lha klu ma lus dang*/ /las rlung thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod rdzas thams cad dang*/ /rlung sems ma lus dbu mar 'gug par mdzod/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo bdud rigs thams cad dang*/ /nyon mongs rags pa'i sems rnams rmongs par mdzod/ /thar pa'i chom rkun 'du 'dzi la sogs pa'i/ /mi bzad glo bur dgra rnams rengs par mdzod// bsgral ba'i zhing gyur dgra bgegs thams cad dang*/ /las rlung nyi khri chig stong bsad par mdzod/ /gzung 'dzin ma rig las kyi dgra bgegs dang*/ /'dzag bde 'pho ba'i bag chags bskrad par mdzod/ /tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mchog /thob nas bstan dang 'gro la phan byed shog /

yi dam chos skyong gi bskang bsdus 'di'ang*/ kun mkhyen rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bskang ba bde stong rol pa nas khol byung du 'bri ba po ni/ dge slong ngag dbang chos 'phel te dge bar gyur cig bkra shis/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 248--PAGE 216--PAGE 206-
